propositions: Cumulative counter blocks in observability.sh persist their offset before CloudWatch accepts the matching datapoint, causing transient put-metric-data failures to permanently lose the interval's count.
When a targeted AWS call fails after offset advancement, the next successful run computes zero from the already-advanced baseline instead of republishing the accumulated delta.

Offset advancement must be reordered to occur only after successful CloudWatch publication across all seven metric streams (replication, voter, merge-change, deploy, shared deferral/interrupt, shared interrupt marker, and G2P).

A PATH-shim regression test demonstrates that forced first-publish failure leaves the offset byte-identical, enabling the second successful run to republish the accumulated delta and then advance the offset.
